publicationBasis.scope: Identify brands in the owner-requested public CityMETER Luxury Brands demo: individual store pins, lists and details.
publicationBasis.rightsStatement: Brand marks remain owned by their respective owners. This request and manifest do not grant additional trademark rights, imply endorsement or establish a new image license.

transformation: Original approved logo bytes embedded unchanged as SVG image data URI; deterministic viewport trim of transparent or solid-neutral outer whitespace only with safety margin, contain fit and neutral backing; no ink cropping, recoloring, inversion or tracing

outputs.scope: Brand identity sprite; symbol viewBox 320×160; original approved image bytes retained
Public brand registry and source/crop metadata

visualReview.contactSheets: All 168 source identities reviewed at 320×160, 44×22 within a 44×28 tile, and 80×40.
visualReview.browser: Chrome verified external SVG use, original SVG/currentColor, PNG, WEBP, white ink and viewport-cropped edge cases.
visualReview.limitation: PIPATCHARA original thin/faint artwork requires the visible brand name and accessible label. Integrating app responsive QA is separate.
